name: 스페셜 덱 세트 ex 「이상해꽃·리자몽·거북왕」
englishName: Venusaur, Charizard & Blastoise Special Deck Set ex

description.text: The Scarlet & Violet Special Deck Set ex Venusaur, Charizard & Blastoise, released in Korean on 13 December 2023: Venusaur ex, Charizard ex and Blastoise ex decks of 60 cards each, three Pokémon coins, two sheets of damage counters and markers, a playmat, three player's guides, a damage counter case and a card box.
